entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places from late afternoon, then changing to gale southwesterly late evening, possibly severe in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale west to northwest winds gusting 120 km/h in exposed places. Winds easing from the south Sunday afternoon. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 60 to 90 mm of rain. Peak rates of 15 to 20 mm/h expected from late Sunday morning. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

entry.title: Heavy Snow Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 10 to 15 cm of snow to settle above 400 metres, with lesser amounts down to about 200 metres. Impact: Travel disruption and damage to trees and powerlines possible. Cold conditions may cause stress for livestock. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.
